row.team_price_text: Pro: $119/mo flat (annual), 1 seat, $19 per additional user
row.evidence: Riddle's single sign-on help page says SSO is part of the Enterprise plan and "Just-in-time provisioning and SCIM are not supported."
row.notes: Unchanged status (none), now stated explicitly by Riddle's SSO help page. Tiers changed since June: the Essential ($59) tier is gone; the pricing page now lists Pro $119, Business $349 and Enterprise $749 base per month on annual billing ($129/$399/$799 monthly), all flat with $19 per additional user. SAML 2.0 and OIDC SSO (Enterprise only) is set up by Riddle's team; users must already hold a seat, there is no JIT. The REST API (Business and Enterprise) covers content, stats and leads, not users.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat price with 1 included seat; $19 per additional user.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Includes the Stats & Builder API (content, not user management).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: $749 base price per month (annual billing); $799 monthly

user_api.notes: The REST API v3 (Business and Enterprise) is described as the complete specification and covers Riddles, stats, leads, AI generation, projects and question banks; it has no user, seat or role endpoints. Capabilities are false on that basis.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/riddle/ returned 404; Riddle's SSO page names Okta as a compatible IdP via a custom SAML/OIDC app.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited one by one from Your user seats; no CSV import documented.

citations.quote: Riddle does not create accounts on the first SSO login. Each user must already have a seat on your organization's Riddle account, with the same email address as in your identity provider. Just-in-time provisioning and SCIM are not supported.
